declarations: market_gate: DELEGATED. I could not see macro when I nominated and I write no market read now. Every vote here is conditional on a Confirmed Uptrend (C1); if the index is under distribution, all eighteen are void however I voted.

fundamentals: PARTIAL for the first time. The packet serves annual eps_g and rev_g, which I read as a partial A letter (C6) and C4's sales check. Quarterly EPS/YoY, ROE, cash flow per share (C), sponsor counts (I) and absolute share volume (S) stay NOT_AVAILABLE and are never inferred.

Substitutes declared: rs_measure = rs_leadership (categorical; no IBD 12-month RS Rating, and rs_spy_20d is the wrong horizon so it never carries step 1). volume_measure = day_vol against its own 20-day, tested at 1.40, where canon says +40% over the 50-day.

base_stage: NOT_AVAILABLE - C19 cannot be enforced, so no name here was checked for a 3rd or 4th stage base. The pivot price is unserved too, so every extension read is sma_distance_pct against this set's 7.84 median, a cross-check standing in for the real C17 test.

Zero SUPPORT is a valid CAN SLIM output, not an abstention. Only 5 of 18 clear day_vol 1.40; only 3 of those read LEADER; and of those three GNW fails C6 at -20.3% EPS, SLDE has no three-year record, and SPGI has no completed base.

bracket.valid is never a veto for me (PM R1) and I have used it as none. Where I cite it I am measuring the distance to the nearest defended level against C20's 7-8% stop ceiling - my own rule about my own position, not a house gate.

data_gaps.impact: C7's new-high confirmation cannot be run on any of the 18; I cannot verify that a single name is breaking to a new high rather than into overhead supply.
C17 measures extension from the peak of the handle. Unserved, so I substituted sma_distance_pct against the 7.84 set median on every name, including my own SLDE.
C19 unenforceable. No name was checked for a late-stage base, the exact condition that turns a breakout into a sell.
C4 and C5 untestable. Only annual FY growth is served, so acceleration and the two-quarter deceleration sell signal cannot be seen anywhere in this set.
C4's +25% sales validation had to run on annual rev_g instead; on JNJ, UBS and TAK that is the difference between a pass and a fail.
C6's 17% ROE test was not run on any of the 18 names.
C6's cash flow at least 20% above reported EPS was not run; fcf_yld is a different measure and I did not substitute it.
The I letter. flow and lens.insti_money are same-day price/volume proxies, not sponsor counts, and I did not vote them.
The S letter. day_vol is a ratio to a name's own average, so even the liquidity half of C8 cannot be tested.
C10's below-80 rejection and 90-99 target cannot be applied; rs_leadership is a three-way label and rs_spy_20d is a 20-day number.
C16 is a 50-day measure. I tested day_vol against its 20-day at 1.40, which is a looser bar on a shorter window.
C1-C3. No follow-through-day or distribution-day count reaches this seat, which is why market_gate stays DELEGATED on all eighteen votes.
